name: git-kit
description: Git and GitHub workflow toolkit: commit and PR creation, GitHub CLI operations, git worktrees, notes, bisect, branch lifecycle setup and post-merge sync, branch cleanup, rebase syncing, merge conflict resolution, commit-shaping guidance, PR review summaries, PR issue-linking and reviewer orchestration, issue drafting, freestanding-issue lifecycle management (create/triage/relate/resolve), dependency updates, gated PR merging, CODEOWNERS management, recovering a stuck Codex-review check, cross-vendor (Claude + Codex) adversarial pre-PR review, and triaging/resolving PR review findings across rounds with a mandated fix-or-file cap.
